title: These are ok. Depends on what you plan to put in them
text:
These are ok. Depends on what you plan to put in them. I mis-read the description on these bags. I thought they were heat-sealing bags. Nope, just zipper type.

I had to play with one for a while to see how they actually opened. With the zip area and a hanging cutout, I thought these might open from the back. They don't - the zip part is the only thing that is sealed - the bags are completely open at the top above the zipper.

I wouldn't put anything expensive in there, that's for sure. I would not buy again.
